title: RobustSec: robustness evaluation of tabular network intrusion detectors under schema-constrained threat models
description: RobustSec is a Python package for evaluating the adversarial robustness of tabular network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). A feature schema states which features an attacker controls, in which direction, and how declared derived features follow them. The same attacks then run under an unconstrained and a schema-constrained threat model, and every scored candidate is repaired to a schema-valid record inside the nominal budget. The package provides FGSM, PGD, Carlini-Wagner L2, label-only random search, score-based greedy search and transfer attacks, PGD adversarial training on repaired or relaxed examples, Wilson and paired confidence intervals, and a reproducible JSON-driven benchmark runner with NSL-KDD and UNSW-NB15 reference results.
